# Olas Build

last-updated: 2026-09-17

> App for building, monetizing, and hiring AI agents in the Olas ecosystem

## Overview

Build is the Olas app for developers and businesses to create AI agents, monetize their work, and hire pre-built agents for various use cases.

## AI Guides

Detailed quickstart guides available as plain text:

- Build an Agent: https://build.olas.network/api/ai-guide/build
- Hire an Agent: https://build.olas.network/api/ai-guide/hire
- Monetize Your Agent: https://build.olas.network/api/ai-guide/monetize

## Key Features

- Build an Agent (https://build.olas.network/build): Create custom AI agents with guided workflows
- Hire an Agent (https://build.olas.network/hire): Browse and deploy pre-built AI agents
- Monetize Your Agent (https://build.olas.network/monetize): Earn rewards by sharing your agents
- Dev Incentives (https://build.olas.network/dev-incentives): Access developer rewards and incentive programs
- Opportunities (https://build.olas.network/opportunities): Discover building opportunities in the ecosystem
- Paths (https://build.olas.network/paths): Follow structured learning paths for agent development

## Documentation

- Website: https://build.olas.network/
- Documentation: https://build.olas.network/docs
- Olas Stack: https://stack.olas.network/
- Disclaimer: https://olas.network/disclaimer

## Technology

Built with Next.js, React, and Web3 technologies. Supports multiple blockchain networks and integrates with the Olas protocol for AI agents.

## Olas Ecosystem

- Olas (hub): https://olas.network/llms.txt
- Marketplace (browse agents, components, blueprints): https://marketplace.olas.network/llms.txt
- Operate (review live staking contracts, run agents): https://operate.olas.network/llms.txt
- Stack (developer docs, frameworks, tutorials): https://stack.olas.network/llms.txt
